title: offramp csproj modernize result
description: The result of `offramp csproj modernize`. See docs/spec/commands/scaffold.md#csproj-modernize.

style.description: The project's style before the command: legacy projects are converted to SDK style.

skipped.description: Why a legacy project is not converted (OFR4304).

compileItems.description: explicit: the Compile list is kept (OFR4301); null for SDK-style projects.

packages.description: packages.config entries that became PackageReference items.

properties.description: Project properties that replace the AssemblyInfo attributes the SDK generates, and GenerateAssembly<Name>Attribute=false for the attributes a shared or generated file keeps (OFR4306).

dropped.description: Properties, items, imports, and targets the SDK makes unnecessary.

files.description: Other files changed or deleted: AssemblyInfo files, packages.config, Directory.Packages.props.

targets.description: One per target framework the original compiled: what differs in the converted build's compiler inputs.

implicitReferencesAdded.description: The SDK's implicit .NET Framework references; allowed.

transitiveReferencesAdded.description: Assemblies of packages the converted project's restore resolved (its own packages' other assemblies, packages flowing from referenced projects); allowed.

frameworkReferencesAdded.description: Framework assemblies that restored packages declare (nuspec frameworkAssemblies); allowed.

facadesRemoved.description: .NET Standard facades the legacy build added and the SDK-style build does not; allowed.

explanations.description: The evidence for the allowed reference changes, by change, reason, and source (ADR 0061).

reason.description: package: the assembly is one of the package's compile assemblies; frameworkAssemblies: the packages declare it; facades: a facade the legacy build added from the named folder.

source.description: The package (Id Version), the declaring packages, or the facades' folder from its recognizable part on.

addedTargets.description: Target frameworks only the converted project has (not compared).

built.description: The converted project built; false when it did not (OFR4303), null when it was not built because the scan's log is gone.

buildErrorCount.description: Distinct errors of the converted build; 0 when it built.

buildErrorCodes.description: The converted build's errors by code (other: no code), the most frequent first, then by code.

buildErrors.description: The first 10 errors, with paths relative to the repository.
